item.name: Cloak of living shadow
item.text: This shifting black cloak seems to drink in surrounding light. Its surface ripples like liquid darkness, and faint whispers can sometimes be heard when it moves.

While wearing this cloak, you gain the following benefits: While you are in dim light or darkness, attack rolls against you are made with disadvantage. As a bonus action while in dim light or darkness, you can become **invisible** until the start of your next turn or until you attack, cast a spell, or move into bright light.

Call the Shadows (1/Day): As an action, you summon 2 Shadows in unoccupied spaces you can see within 30 feet. The shadows act immediately after yours. Roll a d6. on a 1 or 2, the shadows are hostile to your party

item.name: Relic of the Void seer
item.text: This cracked shard of obsidian once served as the focus of a cult leader who sought to pierce the veil between light and darkness. When held, it feels unnaturally cold, and shadows seem to bend toward it.

While attuned to the Relic of the Void Seer, you gain the following benefits: You can see normally in magical and nonmagical darkness to a distance of 60 feet. You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception)** and **Wisdom (Insight) checks made in dim light or darkness. While you are in dim light or darkness, you cannot be surprised.

(1/Day) When a creature you can see within 60 feet makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can use your reaction to twist fate: The creature must reroll the d20 and use the new result.
